name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: A continuously scrolling strip of content — logos, testimonials, announcements — that pauses on hover.

props.name: autoFill
props.description: Whether to automatically duplicate content to fill the container.

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the marquee is paused by default.

props.name: delay
props.description: The delay before the animation starts (in seconds).

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the marquee. Useful for composition.

props.name: loopCount
props.description: The number of times to loop the animation (0 = infinite).

props.name: onComplete
props.description:
Function called when the marquee completes all loops and stops.
Only fires for finite loops (loopCount > 0).

props.name: onLoopComplete
props.description: Function called when the marquee completes one loop iteration.

props.name: pauseOnInteraction
props.description: Whether to pause the marquee on user interaction (hover, focus).

props.name: reverse
props.description: Whether to reverse the animation direction.

props.name: side
props.description: The side/direction the marquee scrolls towards.

props.name: speed
props.description: The speed of the marquee animation in pixels per second.

events.name: onPauseChange
events.description: Function called when the pause status changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A row of items scrolling continuously, pausing when hovered or focused.

examples.title: Reverse
examples.description: Pass `reverse` to scroll the opposite direction.

examples.title: Speed
examples.description: `speed` sets the animation rate in pixels per second (default `50`).

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Set `side` to `"top"` or `"bottom"` to scroll along the vertical axis.

examples.title: Auto fill
examples.description: `autoFill` duplicates a short item list until it fills the container.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Marquee from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/marquee/marquee.marko"; static const LOGOS = ["Acme", "Globex", "Initech", "Umbrella", "Soylent", "Stark", "Wayne", "Wonka"];

Paused: ${paused ? "yes" : "no"}

${logo}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `paused` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `pausedChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `paused:=state`.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source: import Marquee from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/marquee/marquee.marko"; <@item> Acme <@item> Globex <@item> Initech <@item> Umbrella
examples.description: Use `<@item>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose each entry's markup directly.

body.description:
Render prop for `items=` entries.

The item is `T | undefined`, not `T`: a bodyless `<@item/>` produces an
entry with no datum, and the render path below still reaches this body for
it (the `<else if=input.content>` branch). Declaring it as `T` promised a
value this component does not always pass.
